users.title: Users
users.subtitle: M01 — User, organisation and access management (functional requirement §7)
users.name: Name
users.corporateHint: Can see all assigned facilities consolidated (Governance Lead, Executive Viewer).
users.rolesHint: Permissions are granted through roles, never directly to the user.
users.professionHint: Required for users holding the Clinician role.
users.tempPasswordHint: Temporary password — shown only once. The user must change it at first login.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.subtitle: M02 — Alkalma facilities (Al Bateen, Al Falah, …)
facilities.name: Facility
facilities.directorHint: User responsible for the facility (lookup over active Users).

professions.title: Professions
professions.subtitle: M02 — Clinical professions for UCCA/JAWDA criteria and scope of practice
professions.name: Profession

specialties.title: Specialties
specialties.subtitle: M02 — Clinical specialty catalog (configurable, can be enabled/disabled)
specialties.name: Specialty
specialties.codeHint: Stable lowercase identifier without spaces (e.g. clinical_psychology). Cannot be changed later.

criteria.title: Evaluation criteria
criteria.subtitle: M04 — Current UCCA template: clinical domain, universal question, profession-specific interpretation and expected evidence
criteria.codeHint: Short uppercase identifier (e.g. CCA, CRS). Cannot be changed later.
criteria.universalQuestionHint: What is assessed across all professions.
criteria.professionInterpretationHint: How the question reads within the professional's scope of practice.
criteria.examplesEvidenceHint: What the auditor should find in the record to mark compliance.

roles.title: AEGIS roles
roles.subtitle: M01 — Functional roles (System Administrator, Medical Director, Auditor, …)
roles.codeHint: Stable lowercase identifier (e.g. external_auditor). Cannot be changed later.
roles.permissionsHint: Changing the matrix applies immediately to every user holding this role. Permissions travel in the token: users with an active session receive them at their next sign-in.
roles.sysadminLocked: System Administrator holds every permission by definition; its matrix is not editable.

positions.title: Positions
positions.subtitle: M01 — Organisational positions (Group Medical Director, Clinical Director, Consultant Psychiatrist, …). They do not determine permissions.
positions.name: Position
